def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (sign error)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # Fix body_mass_g out of range (5700000 -> likely 5700, divide by 1000 if > 6500)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    # Normalize sex label variants
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip().str.lower()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # Drop rows with missing species (group key)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['species'])
    result = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
    return {k: v for k, v in result.items()}
